rv.q: I think it's impossible to leave this one without a smile on your face, and Cole Porter 's catchy score sounds delectable with this cast.
If you’re looking for a great evening of fun, music, dance and laughter, “Anything Goes” should be one of the first stops on your winter theater cruise.
Without a moment's hesitation, the powers that be at Porchlight Music Theatre should invite a slew of heavyweight New York producers to Chicago to see its bravura production of 'Anything Goes.'
This is a show worth defrosting your car for.
What a performance. What a show!
She is nothing short of a miracle in this role.
This ANYTHING GOES sparkles as a loving, bubbly tribute to Cole Porter.
Murphy? Her ship has already come in, and she brings the boisterous, bawdy heat throughout the show, a welcome development in the frigid depths of a Chicago winter.
For anyone sick of waiting out the freeze, Anything Goes is a worthy trek to warmer climes.
Inspiring vocalists and a jaunty score make Anything Goes a night of fun.
It's so much fun, and you'll have Cole Porter songs in your head for days.
Porchlight Music Theatre is starting its 29th season with a show that will make all who see it glad they did.
As a tonic for our own crazy times, I can think of nothing more pleasing than this sunny and funny revival of Cole Porter’s work of lighthearted genius.
